posts.text: Roche er et av de aller største legemiddelselskapene i verden. Og har enormt med penger og muskler. At de nå har dosert første pasient i en fase 1-studie med Pb-212 sammen med Orano Med, er et ganske sterkt signal. Det viser at de store tar isotopen seriøst og er villige til å satse penger på den i klinikken. Flere slike programmer øker behovet for Pb-212 over tid, og det er bra for alle som leverer til sektoren. Indirekte veldig positivt, for Thor medical. Advancing Targeted Alpha Therapy: First Patient Dosed in Phase 1 Trial 🎯 We are proud to announce that the first patient has been dosed in the Phase 1 clinical study evaluating our joint two-step pretargeted radioimmunotherapy (PRIT) program with Roche. Delivering potent alpha emitters with precision requires novel delivery paradigms. The approach leverages a two-step pretargeting mechanism designed to optimize therapeutic index: 1️⃣Targeting: Bispecific antibodies first localize directly to the tumor. 2️⃣Payload Delivery: Chelated lead-212 is subsequently administered, binding specifically to the pretargeted tumor cells while excess radioactivity clears rapidly to spare healthy tissue. About the trial and target: The target ➡️ Carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) – a validated biomarker heavily overexpressed across colorectal, pancreatic, gastric, and non-small cell lung cancers where significant unmet need persists. Current study ➡️ Ongoing across clinical sites in the U.S., specifically enrolling patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Collaboration ➡️ The clinical program is sponsored and led by Roche, with Orano Med supplying and scaling the chelated lead-212 drug substance via our industrial platform. Thank you to the investigators, clinical teams, and especially the patients participating in this trial as we advance next-generation radiopharmaceuticals. https://www.linkedin.com/posts/oranomed-radiopharmaceuticals-rlt-share-7528488046665609217-HIZL/?utm_source=social_share_send&utm_medium=ios_app&rcm=ACoAADUVyGgBbKFcdpxXInSkiOE2XLD9nnPl2WY&utm_campaign=share_via
